name: Summerfield
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Summerfield, NC 2026
seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Summerfield, North Carolina for 2026: Santa in the barn, a tree lighting and a Stokesdale parade, with dates and prices checked.
lede: Summerfield keeps its Christmas close to the farm and the town park, with Santa in the barn at Summerfield Farms, a tree lot with wagon rides and the town tree lighting at the athletic park.
celebrates: Summerfield Farms anchors the season with Santa and Smores, an 11th annual reserved visit where each family sees Santa in the barn, has a photo taken, meets Mrs. Claus, visits farm animals and takes home an s'mores kit, according to the farm. The farm also runs a Christmas tree lot at the Well Truck with holiday wagon rides, and a cookies with Mrs. Claus morning. The Town of Summerfield lights its tree on December 5 at Summerfield Athletic Park with music, dancing, s'mores and Santa, and neighboring Stokesdale holds a Christmas parade on December 12.
lastyear: We did not find a published 2025 recap for Summerfield's holiday events, so this page leans on the host pages for 2026. The farm calls its Santa and Smores the 11th annual, which means it also ran in 2025, and the town's earlier tree lighting pages describe a similar evening of music, s'mores and Santa. The Tree Decorating Contest is new for 2026, according to the town.
facts: Summerfield Farms is at 3203 Pleasant Ridge Road and sells Santa and Smores by reservation only, in 15 minute arrival windows. The farm sets aside December 6 as a VIP night and December 7 as a sensory friendly night, according to its event page. The town's tree lighting is at Summerfield Athletic Park on US 220 North, and the town has added a Tree Decorating Contest for 2026.
trains: Summerfield does not have its own holiday train, and we did not find a train event within the town. The nearest train experience on our museum guide is the N.C. Transportation Museum at the old Spencer Shops in Spencer, which lists admission from $10 or $20 with a 25 minute train ride. Winter Glow at the Point in High Point also has a train ride.
train_links: The old Spencer Shops with train rides and Christmas train tips, listed on our museum guide.
traditions: Santa and Smores at Summerfield Farms
An 11th annual reserved visit with Santa in the barn, a photo, Mrs. Claus and an s'mores kit.
A Christmas tree lot at the Well Truck with holiday wagon rides on November 27.
Music, dancing, s'mores, Santa and a new Tree Decorating Contest on December 5.

kidfact: Summerfield's Santa waits in a barn on a farm, and you can make s'mores with him nearby.
faq: Where can kids meet Santa in Summerfield?

Santa and Smores at Summerfield Farms is a reserved visit with Santa in the barn, from November 28 to December 7, 2026. Santa also attends the town tree lighting on December 5 at Summerfield Athletic Park, according to the Town of Summerfield.
Is there a Christmas parade in Summerfield?
We did not find a Summerfield parade for 2026. Neighboring Stokesdale holds its Christmas parade on Saturday, December 12 at 2 pm, according to the Town of Stokesdale, and it is free to watch.
Do I need a reservation for Christmas events in Summerfield?

Santa and Smores requires advance reservations with 15 minute arrival windows, and the Trees and Cheers wagon rides need advance Eventbrite tickets. The town tree lighting does not list a ticket requirement.
When is the Summerfield tree lighting?
The Town of Summerfield lists the tree lighting for Saturday, December 5, 2026 at 5:30 pm at Summerfield Athletic Park.
note: Stokesdale folds into this page. Facts: not from a host page are limited to the museum guide link.
intro_html:

We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.
